senses.sense_definition: rekening houdend met de invloed op het milieu

examples.text: Steeds meer mensen maken <w>milieubewuste</w> keuzes in de supermarkt.

target_lang_translations.en: More and more people are making <w>environmentally conscious</w> choices at the supermarket.

examples.text: Het bedrijf probeert op een <w>milieubewuste</w> manier te produceren.

target_lang_translations.en: The company is trying to produce in an <w>eco-friendly</w> way.

target_lang_definitions.en: Taking into account the impact on the environment; acting in a way that minimizes harm to nature.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: General term for being aware of environmental issues.
Often used for products or practices that are not harmful to the environment.
Standard term for actions or products that are safe for the environment.
